snippet.title: Fire Combat
snippet.description: The Earth is under threat from a massive heatwave. The city of Spark is overwhelmed by outbreaks of fire, but a team of heroes will rise to fight the flames and rescue the victims. Immerse yourself in this action-packed and strategic adventure: extinguish the fires, save the items, survive, and become a legendary firefighter in Fire Combat!
